header.description: (Required) Message ID defined by the Participant. The messageContextID is used in the following ways: 1. To provide a contextID for the message exchange. The participant/e-Hub uses the contextID of the original request when delivering its corresponding MACK(s). 2. If the Recipient is on FTP, the filename is set to .zip. 3. The name of the archive files is set to .zip. 4. To provide context to the failure messages to be returned where the incoming payload is unreadable such as, the payload is schema invalid. Format of is: [TransactionGroup 0-9_a-z]{1,4} + [Priority h|m|l] + "_" + [FromParticipantID]{1,10} + "_" + [0-9_a-z]{1,18} NOTE: Transaction Group ‘PTPE’ will be used to exchange free form information and/or attachments between the participants

description.content: ## Introduction The P2PMessagingSync API is a B2B SMP APIs used to exchange the following Peer-to-Peer information via the e-Hub: - Free-form information - Documents (also called Attachments). The P2PMessagingSync API supports exchange of the following attachment types (configurable): pdf, csv, jpeg, jpe, jpg, gif, zip & txt. In future, this API will support additional attachment types. For details on how to get access and business rules for this API:
